fields.title: Verify AS04 and AS09-AS12 audit claims and current coverage

data.text:
Verified AS04 and AS09-AS12 against parent 473674b and current main fc8d486.

AS09: thirteen tests had genuine blind spots, plus the separate V1 classifier test. Ten permitted alternate/early-return outcomes, one compared repeated ready results without checking unpublished metadata, A09 ignored the update result, and the memo test deleted the file first then skipped the other two damage cases. Current assertions pin the documented outcomes and exercise every memo damage. The phrase "tests could not fail" overstates this: most could fail on other regressions. "Compared a value with itself" was two separate ready invocations, effectively an invariant/determinism check that did not verify the stated metadata contract. V1 now calls the production push_outcome on the actual porcelain output, including the server race (AS16).

AS04: the expensive Comment::get implementation is confirmed and fixed, including search. Partial refutation of the ledger wording: the comments command's three get calls were Value::get on already-built JSON, both before and after; shown_comment builds each object once. It did not call Comment::get three times per printed comment. Current state/issue.rs test compares get with to_value, which now uses get; this checks consistency/key order but is not an independent value oracle or allocation/performance test. No measured speedup claimed.

AS10: copied the exact current environment test into the archived old source. It fails for init/export/ready because BEAD_FAILPOINTS, BEAD_REMOTE and GIT_* survive, and passes against current roundtrip.py. This is the existing subprocess-interception environment test, not a live remote roundtrip. Logs: /tmp/beadroll-as-verification-48dcjxge/before-as10.log and current-as10.log.

AS11: confirmed shared helpers and redundant wrappers/allocations removed; tempfile moved to dev-dependencies (not deleted), uuid resolves with v4 and no v7, the four unused allowlist entries were BSD-2-Clause/BSD-3-Clause/ISC/Zlib. Old fuzz FORMATS/sorted helpers had no target consumer; only segment/import targets remain. cargo deny --locked check licenses passed; cargo clippy --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings passed.

AS12: listed stale examples confirmed in the parent and corrected: segment/import fuzz targets, 24 sync rounds, 26 numbered reviews, existing compile-fail doctests, golden provenance and removed API names. I did not treat "about thirty" as a rigorously counted defect total.

Validation: 16 targeted Rust tests passed (AS09 cases, an extra G35 case and AS04). V1 exercised the C control's client race, policy refusal and server race, but all five translated locale configurations were skipped because translations are unavailable here. No mutation testing of every AS09 assertion or performance benchmark was run. The earlier full baseline is green at this same commit. No tracked source or document changes; only local scratch evidence and tracker writes. Honesty check found no test weakening or fabricated evidence in this verification; the AS04 overstatement and coverage limits are explicitly disclosed.

data.reason: Verified claims on main fc8d486; confirmed AS09 and AS10-AS12 with qualifications, corrected AS04 comments-path overstatement, recorded evidence and coverage limits.

fields.title: Correct AS04 evidence and exercise translated V1 cases

data.text:
All three requested follow-ups completed and pushed to main in 56405cc.

AS04 ledger now limits the unnecessary object construction to Comment::get/search and explicitly corrects the earlier claim about the comments command. Replaced the coupled test with three tests under state::issue::tests, moved beside issue.rs to keep the source under 500 lines. Both member reads and whole objects are checked against literal expected JSON and explicit field order. Cases include native comments with/without a place, missing members, the existing u64-to-i64 sequence saturation, and imported members including null and a custom field. Expected timestamps and ids are literals; neither method under test supplies the expected object.

V1 was run with real Git 2.43.0 and temporary locale data/catalogs. Compiled de_DE.UTF-8, fr_FR.UTF-8, fr_FR.ISO8859-1 and en_US.UTF-8 using localedef --no-archive under /tmp/beadroll-followups-larni2rd/locales. Downloaded and extracted Ubuntu language-pack-de-base and language-pack-fr-base 1:24.04+20260905 into scratch, without installing packages. A scratch PATH wrapper executes /usr/bin/git with GIT_TEXTDOMAINDIR pointing to those catalogs, because the fixtures correctly scrub inherited GIT_* variables. LOCPATH selects the scratch locales. Independent probes confirmed translated German/French diagnostics for all five configurations.

cargo nextest run --locked -p beadroll -E 'test(/^hardening::v1::v1_push_side_translation::/)' --success-output immediate --failure-output immediate: both tests passed, no translated configuration skipped. This covers C plus five translated configurations for client rejection, policy refusal and server ref-update race, and the three translated end-to-end sync-retry scenarios. Reusable runner and log: /tmp/beadroll-followups-larni2rd/run_v1.py and v1-translated.log. No SSH, Git, shell or system locale configuration was changed.

Validation before changes: 1298 tests passed, 11 skipped; 11 doctests and 15 infra tests passed. After changes: 1300 tests passed, 11 skipped; 11 doctests and 15 infra tests passed. All three targeted new tests passed; cargo fmt --all -- --check and workspace/all-targets/all-features Clippy with -D warnings -D clippy::mod_module_files passed. git diff --check clean. Runtime implementation is unchanged. Git push confirmed main at 56405cc and the working tree is clean. Self-review checked the literal expectations and test diff; no external independent review or performance benchmark is claimed.
